svg.text: LLM INFERENCE ACCELERATION PANORAMA: TP / PP / DP / EP (DEEPEP) / MTP / PREFIX / FP8
FP8 + Attention DP × Expert EP (DeepEP+EPLB) + MTP + Prefix Cache Lifts TPS 5.18x
64-GPU H200 Cluster (671B MoE & 405B Dense): Tier 1 Cross-Node TP=16 (46.5ms TPOT, $1.28/1M) vs. Tier 4 (11.6ms TPOT, $0.25/1M)
🧭 7 Inference Levers: What Optimizes TTFT vs. TPOT vs. TPS?
• TP (Tensor Parallel): Pools HBM BW & FLOPs -> Cuts TTFT & TPOT
⛔ Iron Rule: Never stretch TP across inter-node RDMA (2L AllReduces!)
• PP (Pipeline Parallel): Fits 405B Dense across nodes -> Lifts System TPS
(Does NOT cut single-request TPOT; sends 1 activation per stage boundary)
• Attention DP: Zero Attention comm & zero KV duplication -> Scales TPS
• MoE EP (DeepEP Dispatch/Combine + EPLB): Consolidates tokens per
expert across 32–64 GPUs so expert GEMMs cross the Roofline ridge
• MTP / EAGLE-3 Speculative Decoding: Cuts Decode TPOT by 1.8x–2.5x
• Prefix Caching: Cuts TTFT 3x–5x | FP8/NVFP4: Doubles BW & FLOPs
⛔ Tier 1 Trap: Cross-Node TP=16 on 671B MoE (64 GPUs):
• P99 Decode TPOT: 46.5ms (122 cross-node AllReduces/token!)
• Cluster Output TPS: Only 24,800 tok/s (387 tok/s/GPU)
• Cost per 1M Output Tokens: $1.28 / 1M
🏆 Tier 4: Canonical Slicing for 70B, 405B & 671B MoE
1. Dense 70B (`Llama-3.3-70B` on H200/H100):
• `FP8 + Intra-Node TP=4 (DP=2)` or `TP=8 + EAGLE-3 + Prefix Cache`
2. Dense 405B (`Llama-3.1-405B` on 1x H200 vs 2x H100):
• 1x 8-GPU H200 (`1,128GB`): `FP8 + TP=8` (zero inter-node traffic!)
• 2x 8-GPU H100 (`80GB`): `FP8 + Intra-Node TP=8 × Inter-Node PP=2`
3. Sparse 671B MoE (`DeepSeek-V3/R1` on 64 GPUs):
• Prefill: `FP8 + Attn DP=8 × TP=4 + Expert EP=32 (DeepEP High-TP)`
• Decode: `FP8 + Attn DP=64 × TP=1 + EP=64 (IBGDA+EPLB) + MTP`
Tier 4 Verified 64-GPU Cluster Benchmarks (671B MoE):
• P99 TTFT: 145.0 ms | P99 Decode TPOT: 11.6 ms (MTP 2.1x)
• Cluster Output Throughput: 128,400 tok/s (5.18x vs. Tier 1)
• Cost per 1M Output Tokens: $0.25 / 1M (-80.5% savings)
